## Boundary Rules

Public PR checks must not require AWS credentials, Terraform state, ECR access, production secret material, or write access to riido-client.; Tag/manual runtime CD may use live AWS only outside pull_request gates.; Runtime artifact CD execution remains owned by riido-control-plane while topology and private evidence remain owned by riido-infra.; Private gates may consume public tags and redacted summaries but must not push account-specific state or raw secret values back to this public repository.; Docker is optional for local release preparation and is not a required public PR dependency..
